# Nanik

> Personalized bedtime stories for kids, narrated in a parent's true voice, in 100+ languages.

Nanik is an iOS app where a parent or guardian creates a personalized bedtime story starring a hero they describe, or a photo of a child's favorite toy. Nanik writes the story, illustrates it, and narrates it aloud. Parents can clone their own voice from a short recording so the story is read in a familiar voice, or choose a storyteller style inspired by classic children's authors (for example Hans Christian Andersen, the Brothers Grimm, Astrid Lindgren, Roald Dahl, and Hovhannes Tumanyan).

## Key facts

- Story text and narration are available in 100+ languages (102 languages), with Armenian, English, and Russian as the primary/featured languages in the app UI, plus a dedicated European languages group on https://nanik.app/languages.html.
- The marketing site UI can be switched to Armenian, Russian, English, and major European languages via the language picker in the header.
- Voice clone: parents record about a 10-second voice sample once, then Nanik clones that voice for narrating stories to their child.
- Storyteller styles: stories can be told in the spirit of classic children's authors and folktale traditions, not celebrity or actor voices.
- Hero creation: type a description of a hero, or take a photo of a favorite toy/object, which Nanik turns into an illustrated story character.
- Worlds: Forest, Cave, Village, City, Mars, underwater, or a custom place typed by the parent.
- Emotional support themes: stories can gently weave in a feeling or habit the child needs that day (calm, courage, healthy habits, etc.).
- Stories are saved to a personal library, can be continued as new chapters with the same hero, and are designed for about a 3-minute read-aloud.
- Free plan: 2 personalized stories (lifetime) and 1 voice clone. Background music while listening/reading is free for everyone.
- Nanik Plus (subscription): 30 personalized stories per month, up to 3 voice clones, and advanced storytelling. Yearly Nanik Plus includes a 3-day free trial (offered by Apple).
- Nanik is operated by a parent or guardian, not a child-solo "Kids Category" app.
- Platform: iOS, officially released on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762894314). Android/Play Market is planned.
